session.lock.outcome: Hyprlock covers every output immediately; completed only when the locker process is observed

session.logout.outcome: After confirmation only the current session ends (Hyprland exit, or logind terminate-session for the known session ID)

session.reboot.outcome: After confirmation logind accepts the reboot request

session.shutdown.outcome: After confirmation logind accepts the power-off request

session.suspend.outcome: logind accepts the suspend request without confirmation; Hypridle locks before sleep

session.hibernate.outcome: Hibernate is requested only when logind reports CanHibernate yes or challenge

session.power_screen.outcome: Wlogout opens with the same session actions and confirmations; hibernate is shown only when available

session.auth.outcome: Hyprpolkitagent is the running authentication agent of the session; a foreign agent is reported and left running

session.status.outcome: status_read.sh session reports hibernate availability, the authentication owner and lock state

session.idle.outcome: Hypridle dims at 240 s, locks at 300 s and locks before sleep (existing behavior preserved)

appearance.compositor.outcome: Hyprland borders, groups, rounding, opacity and shadows follow the active variant after a safe config reload

appearance.lock_screen.outcome: Hyprlock uses the active variant for background, text, input, focus, checking and error states

appearance.power_screen.outcome: Wlogout uses the generated GTK palette and variant-matched Breeze icons

appearance.greeter.outcome: The SDDM greeter matches the desktop theme

appearance.terminal_tools.outcome: btop and cava use the active palette; fastfetch, htop and other terminal tools follow the terminal palette

appearance.dialogs.outcome: The Tk keybinding viewer reads the generated palette; Zenity, Satty, Qalculate and other GTK/Qt tools use the global mappings

wallpaper.change.outcome: A random wallpaper is applied to every output, readiness is published and the Wlogout cache link is updated (preserved)

nightlight.toggle.outcome: One key switches between daylight and warm color temperature

capture.annotate.outcome: Hyprshot window/output/region capture opens in Satty for annotation, copy and save (preserved)

clipboard.history.outcome: Clipboard history opens in the selected terminal with a stable window identity (preserved)

notes.open.outcome: Notes open in the selected TUI editor inside the notes directory; names cannot escape it

music.play.outcome: The Nightfall player streams the album with ffplay in a terminal (preserved; needs ffmpeg)
